result.summary: The page is a food delivery home screen that mostly renders correctly. The main visual defect is in the bottom navigation bar, where a dark horizontal bar (likely the Android home indicator or a mis-rendered element) overlaps the search and orders/receipt icons, and the bottom tab bar lacks labels. Other elements (header, promo banner, carousels, restaurant cards) look intact.

issues.description: A dark horizontal bar overlaps the search and orders (receipt) icons in the bottom navigation bar, partially covering them. It appears the system gesture/home indicator is drawn on top of the tab bar content rather than the bar being inset below it, or a stray element is rendering over the nav.
issues.suggestion: Apply safe-area/system-bar bottom insets to the bottom navigation so the home indicator does not overlap the tab icons, or remove the stray overlapping element.

issues.description: Bottom navigation tabs are icon-only with no text labels, and the icons are cut off close to the screen edge, making the destinations less clear.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each tab icon and ensure the tab bar has adequate height/padding above the system navigation area.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza, -20%) shows the image only; its title, rating, and delivery info are not visible before the nav bar, so the card reads as incomplete at the current scroll position.
issues.suggestion: This is likely just viewport cut-off; verify the card's metadata renders when scrolled and consider adding bottom padding so content is not hidden behind the nav bar.
